title: Truck tires
selectHint: Press any wheel on the drawing to see it or work on it
firstTime: No tires are recorded on this truck yet. Press any empty wheel and choose “Register a tire that is already on the truck” — you can fill every empty wheel in one go.

view.label: View
view.unsupported: This device cannot show the 3D view, so you are back on the simple drawing — everything works from it.
view.failed: The 3D view stopped, so you are back on the simple drawing — everything works from it.
view.hint3d: Drag to turn the truck, press a wheel to choose it. If it is slow on this device, go back to the simple drawing.

intent.prompt: What do you want to do with this wheel?
intent.fitDesc: A new tire from stock or a used one. Recorded inside an open work order and counted against stock.
intent.register: Register a tire that is already on the truck
intent.registerDesc: The tire is already fitted. Nothing leaves stock and no work order is needed. For first-time setup only.

needWo.closed: This work order is closed, so tires cannot be fitted or taken off in it. Reopen it if there is still work to do.
needWo.reopened: The work order is open again
needWo.hasOpenFit: Fitting a tire is recorded inside a work order. This truck has an open one — continue there.
needWo.hasOpenDismount: Taking a tire off is recorded inside a work order. This truck has an open one — continue there.
needWo.goOpen: Go to the open work order, at this wheel
needWo.noneFit: Fitting a tire must be recorded inside an open work order, and this truck has none right now. Open one from the truck's page, then open the truck's tires from inside it.
needWo.noneDismount: Taking a tire off must be recorded inside an open work order, and this truck has none right now. Open one from the truck's page, then open the truck's tires from inside it.
needWo.goTruck: Go to the truck's page to open a work order

field.odometerMissing: Without the odometer we cannot tell how far the tire runs.
field.dotHint: Printed on the tire's sidewall after the letters DOT. Leave it empty if you cannot read it.

mount.newExplain: One tire will be taken from the type you choose.
mount.zeroWarn: The recorded stock of this type has run out. If the tire is really in front of you, carry on — the count goes below zero until stock is corrected.
mount.customWarn: This type is not recorded in stock, so its count will be negative until it is.
mount.search: Search by brand, size or DOT
mount.sizeDiffers: This tire's size differs from the truck's ({{size}}). Check before fitting.

why.replacement: Replacing a tire that came off

mount.noUsed: No used tire is ready to fit
mount.noUsedHow: A tire gets here when it is taken off a truck for “Rotation” or “Other”, when it comes back from repair or retreading, or when you record used tires lying in the workshop from the “Tires & stock” page.

dismount.title: Take the tire off
dismount.reasonPrompt: Why is it coming off? The reason decides where the tire goes.
dismount.backwards: This is lower than the odometer when it was fitted ({{km}} km). Check the reading.
dismount.scrapTitle: The tire will be scrapped — are you sure?
dismount.scrapBody: “{{reason}}” means {{tire}} is recorded as scrap, leaves the books and cannot be fitted again. If it is still usable, go back and choose another reason.

done.scrapped: Tire taken off and scrapped. If that was a mistake, put it back from the list below.
done.in_stock_used: Tire taken off, now in used stock. If that was a mistake, put it back from the list below.
done.in_repair: Tire taken off, now in repair. If that was a mistake, put it back from the list below.
done.retreading: Tire taken off, now at the retreader. If that was a mistake, put it back from the list below.

outcome.scrapped: Recorded as scrap and leaves stock — cannot be fitted again
outcome.in_repair: Goes to repair, then back to used stock
outcome.retreading: Goes to the retreader, then back to used stock
outcome.in_stock_used: Goes back to used stock and can be fitted again

onboard.ranKm: How far has the tire already run? (roughly)
onboard.ranKmHint: Leave it empty if you do not know — counting starts from zero.
onboard.odometerRequired: Enter the truck's odometer — without it the tires' run cannot be counted from today.
onboard.sameForAll: Record the same details on every empty wheel (wheels: {{n}})
onboard.sameForAllHint: The DOT number is recorded for this wheel only. Other empty spare slots are not included.
onboard.confirmBody: {{brand}} will be recorded on every empty wheel — wheels: {{n}} — at truck odometer {{km}} km. Nothing leaves stock. If some wheel carries a different brand, cancel and register it on its own.
onboard.partial: Only some were registered before the problem — count: {{n}}

undoMount.heading: Fitted by mistake?
undoMount.explain: If this tire was recorded on this wheel by mistake, you can cancel the fitting as if it never happened.
undoMount.button: Fitted by mistake — cancel the fitting
undoMount.title: Cancel the fitting?
undoMount.backToNew: {{tire}} comes off this wheel and goes back into new stock, as if it was never fitted.
undoMount.backToUsed: {{tire}} comes off this wheel and goes back to used stock.
undoMount.forget: The record of {{tire}} on this wheel is removed entirely. Stock does not change.

taken.title: Taken off in this work order
taken.hint: If a tire was taken off by mistake, put it back from here.
taken.undoBody: The tire goes back on {{where}} as if it was never taken off.
taken.undone: The tire is back on its wheel

discard.title: Leave what you typed?
discard.body: What you typed for this wheel has not been saved and will be lost.
